description_ko: 거대한 한쪽 전지가위 팔과 작은 반대팔을 가진 비대칭 정원 기계. 상부 어깨/등의 큰 꽃 유리함과 낮게 숙인 인형 얼굴을 대비시킨다.

references.role: Initial generation identity, gardening motifs, palette and clean 2D rendering reference only; no head/body/pose lock
Initial generation open shell, winding construction and material reference only; no proportions lock

visual_qa.silhouette: One very high massive image-right shoulder and integrated pruning-claw arm, one low slender caretaker arm and empty hand, small offset hunched face, exactly two planted leg/foot contacts. No extra legs or knuckle walking.
visual_qa.identity: Closed-eye porcelain caretaker mask, cap and short curls retained as a small detail. One off-center upper shoulder/back glass chamber contains one blue flower with green stem. Teal apron panels, ceramic armor and brass joints retained.
visual_qa.mechanics: Two large curved pruning blades are joined at one visible round brass hinge at the end of the dominant arm; arm elbow construction is readable. No loose handheld scissors. A small lower back/hip winding drum and curled spring are attached.
visual_qa.framing: Entire two-blade claw, flower pod, cap, small hand and both feet are within frame with background visible around all tips.

limits: Single-view 2D concept candidate, not selected; no Tripo reconstruction, multi-view consistency, mesh fitting or rig tested.
